fleet-view.page.title: Fleet View
fleet-view.empty.title: No racks yet
fleet-view.empty.body: Once the printers have loaded, two racks are laid out for you to start from.
fleet-view.panel.label: Floor and racks
fleet-view.batch.count: {count, plural, one {# printer selected} other {# printers selected}}
fleet-view.batch.none.pause: None of these printers is printing.
fleet-view.batch.none.resume: None of these printers is paused.
fleet-view.batch.none.stop: None of these printers is printing or paused.
fleet-view.batch.none.ready: None of these printers waits for a cleared bed.
fleet-view.batch.none.unready: None of these printers is marked ready.
fleet-view.batch.none.preheat: Every one of these printers is busy or not reporting.

fleet-view.floor.label: Floor plan
fleet-view.edit.name: Name
fleet-view.edit.shelfRows: Shelves from the top: name and slots
fleet-view.edit.deleteNote: {count, plural, =0 {It holds no printers.} one {Its # printer goes back to the printers to place.} other {Its # printers go back to the printers to place.}} Cancel the edit to bring it back.
fleet-view.edit.noRoom: There is no room there. Move it to free cells.
fleet-view.edit.noFit: That slot cannot hold it. An XL needs two free slots side by side.
fleet-view.edit.lost: {count, plural, one {# printer moved to Unplaced} other {# printers moved to Unplaced}}
fleet-view.file.title: Import a layout
fleet-view.file.description: Drop a YAML or JSON layout file, or paste it below. Printers are matched by name or serial number. The import becomes your draft; nothing changes until you save.
fleet-view.file.drop: Drop a layout file here or choose one
fleet-view.file.taken: Layout imported. Save it to keep it.
fleet-view.file.summary: {units, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}}, {slots, plural, one {# slot} other {# slots}}, {placed, plural, one {# printer placed} other {# printers placed}}.
fleet-view.file.report.unknown: {count, plural, one {# printer is not on this server; its slot stays empty:} other {# printers are not on this server; their slots stay empty:}}
fleet-view.file.report.repeated: {count, plural, one {# printer is named twice; it keeps its first slot:} other {# printers are named twice; each keeps its first slot:}}
fleet-view.file.report.misfit: {count, plural, one {# printer does not fit its slot and stays unplaced:} other {# printers do not fit their slots and stay unplaced:}}
fleet-view.file.report.moved: {count, plural, one {# unit was put on the first free spot instead of its own:} other {# units were put on the first free spot instead of their own:}}
fleet-view.file.error.syntax: The file is not valid YAML: {detail}
fleet-view.file.error.units: The file needs a list of units under "units".
fleet-view.file.error.version: The file is version {found}; this page reads version {expected}.
fleet-view.file.error.room: {where} does not fit anywhere on the floor.
fleet-view.file.error.placeholder: {where}: placeholder is {value}; it must be computer or service.
fleet-view.edit.placeHint: Drag onto any slot, on the floor or in a rack, or click one and then click a slot. Drag one back here to take it off. Computer and Service keep a slot free and go on as many slots as you like.
fleet-view.edit.moveRack: Drag to move the rack. Drop a printer here to put it on the first free slot.
fleet-view.layout.loadFailed: The shared layout could not be read. It is tried again in a moment.
fleet-view.layout.saveFailed: The layout could not be saved. Your changes are still here; try Done again.
fleet-view.layout.changedNote: {who} saved the floor plan while you were editing. Save over it with your changes, or close this and press Cancel to see theirs.
fleet-view.card.missingBody: Pick a rack in this card's settings, or the rack it showed is no longer in the layout.
